x: With Stuart Barratt in support we just won the Surrey team race by one point. All in all a good afternoon for our runners but an embarrassment to a club of our size that we had to rely on outside help for one of our major promotions of the year.
Among the festivities was a drink-a-yard-of-ale competition in which Stuart Barratt downed the 2¼-odd pints of "Youngs" in 67 seconds to be the only successful competitor.
